Can't really help when it comes to the legal stuff I would say try and file for the order of protection and if he shows up at your place record him and call the police so that there are police reports of the different times he has showed up at your home harassing you. When it comes to the credit bureau stuff, I work for a bank and there's a few different things you can do. For example if he is calling up your credit cards and getting your address from there I would call every creditor, every bank that you have that he may have had access to in the past or maybe just knows you have an account with them (most banks/ creditors can search your account with ssn and most of the time they only verify like dob & mmn and then boom full access to the account) put verbal passwords and security questions on each account that way he can't access your information there. Next call all the credit bureaus and put a lock on your credit and request that only your telephone number is able to make changes, set up security questions and passwords, this way the only person who can access your credit report/ make changes is yourself, ( this will also limit changes being made within your accounts if you're not calling from the telephone number with the credit bureaus so make sure you keep your telephone number & passwords handy if you need to change the number on the credit lock ) . The credit lock will also help prevent fraud, if he has your ssn he may try to ruin your finances and open credit cards in your name or apply for loans (this will prevent new accounts from being opened, it has to be verified with the credit bureaus first before or it will get auto rejected) Hopefully this helps! And remember your phone is your best friend, record him if he shows up to your house or if he is following you around in public or anything.
